text:
maya: Heads-up — Aurora Health just uploaded a SIG/CAIQ and asked for answers + evidence for a 6-week POC. They want completed questionnaire and artifacts by 2025-07-08. Link: https://redwood.share/aurora/SIG_CA IQ.xlsx (internal share). Can security pick this up? cc @liam @evan

liam: On it. Quick clarifying Q: will the POC use real customer data or synthetic? that affects evidence/controls scope.

maya: POC will use a de-identified subset of production data hosted in a Dedicated env (us-west-2). They explicitly want encryption-at-rest details + SOC2 references.

liam: thanks. I can run an initial mapping of SIG -> our controls and flag gaps. ETA: 2 business days for mapping + initial artifact list. I'll create a risk ticket.

sec-bot: New ticket created: `RISK-2025-145` — https://redwood.ops/risk/RISK-2025-145 (assigned to liam).

ev an: FYI — for the questionnaire there are a few infra/keys questions that need engineering input: key rotation, KMS integration, and where KV caches reside for POC. @eng-runtime might be needed.

maya: Aurora confirmed they will authenticate via SAML SSO. Also asked whether we can provide network diagram and customer-specific data handling note.

liam: OK — here's a short plan:
```
- Triage & map SIG controls -> internal artifacts
- Collect artifacts: SOC2 summary, KMS config, disk encryption settings, network diagram, data flow for POC
- Identify gaps and propose compensating controls or timeline to remediate
- Deliver answers + attachments to Aurora by 2025-07-08
Assign: liam (security lead), evan (engineering evidence), maya (customer coordination)
```

liam: I'll need the Spreadsheet they uploaded (full) and the contact at Aurora to schedule a 30-min security scoping call. maya, can you drop the contact?

maya: Dropping contact now — Aurora PM: sara.connors@aurorahealth.com. Also uploaded full sig file to the share and added the POC statement of work: https://redwood.share/aurora/POC_SOW.pdf :paperclip:

evan: I'll pull the KMS and disk-encryption configs from the dedicated account and drop evidence in the ticket. Might take a day.

liam: Great. One heads-up: the questionnaire asks about data residency and access control for the dedicated pool — we need to confirm which team owns the Dedicated instance (billing/infra). @maya can you confirm if this is on our Dedicated fleet or reserved for Aurora?

maya: It's on our Dedicated fleet but provisioned specifically for Aurora under a reserved capacity group. I'll confirm resource owner and get the ARN/IDs.

liam: Perfect. Once I have artifacts I'll start populating the spreadsheet and mark anything that requires longer remediation. If anything is high-risk we'll propose a compensating control for the POC (e.g., strict access window, IAM review).

maya: Also a scheduling note — Aurora asked for a security call next Wednesday PST. Can you make that? :calendar: @liam @evan

liam: I can do Wed 10am PST. evan?

ev an: I can make 10am. I'll prepare a short slide with KMS/key rotation details.

liam: Cool. I'll update the ticket with the timeline and link to the shared spreadsheet and set status to `in_progress`. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: RISK-2025-145 status updated to `in_progress` (owner: liam).
